title: Staged Endpoint Order Re-Quote of a Cancelled Endpoint Line
content:
This Hardware Procurement rule prices the revision of a client's Staged Endpoint Order quote for the same part number and quantity as a Standard Endpoint Order that was cancelled after its purchase order, when the client switches that line to the staged quote so the units ship imaged and enrolled. The revision keeps the staged quote's number, re-dates it to the revision day so a new validity period starts, and replaces its total. Only such a staged re-quote of a cancelled endpoint line is priced here.

**Waiting state.** A re-quote of a cancelled endpoint line is priced only after the order it re-quotes shows status cancelled and its ledger carries the cancellation fee charged on it. Put the other way round: while the endpoint order whose line is taken over does not yet show status cancelled, or its ledger does not yet carry the cancellation fee charged on it, the re-quote is not priced.

**Scope of the pricing.** For a staged re-quote of a cancelled endpoint line, and only for such a re-quote, the unit price is the cancelled order's unit price carried over unchanged, and the quote total is figured under this staged re-quote schedule. A re-issue of a lapsed infrastructure quote follows the re-issue schedule, and every other quote's unit price stays the distributor unit cost times one plus the effective markup, rounded half up to the cent, and its total stays the quantity times the unit price, plus the staging fee per unit times the quantity, plus the handling fee, plus the rush fee when rush is requested where rush processing is available.

## Invocation: `revise_staged_quote_eb003c71`

**Capability.** Revises a client's quoted Staged Endpoint Order so that it takes over the line of another hardware order of the same units. One call keeps the staged quote's number and quoted status, re-dates it to today so a new validity period starts, sets its unit price to the source order's unit price and replaces its quote total with the total passed in. The client sees the staged quote re-issued with today's date and the new total, ready to sign.

**How it is invoked.** `revise_staged_quote_eb003c71` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `hardware_order_id` | reference number of the quoted Staged Endpoint Order being revised, as returned by the hardware order lookup for this client | identifier |
| `source_order_id` | reference number of the hardware order whose line the staged quote takes over, as returned by the hardware order lookup for this client | identifier |
| `quote_total_usd` | the revised quote total in USD | amount rounded half up to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the revised order reference, its quote number (HQ- followed by 6 digits), its new quote date (YYYY-MM-DD), its unit price and its revised quote total in USD with 2 decimal places. Receiving it means the revision is on record.
